name: Gemini Notebook
desc: Research notebook grounded in your own sources
desc_zh: 基于自有资料作答的研究笔记本
solves: Research scattered across PDFs and notes; Gemini Notebook answers from your sources and now runs code inside them.
solves_zh: 资料散落在 PDF 和笔记里，Gemini Notebook 依据你的来源作答，还能运行代码。
best_for: You have thirty papers for a review and need the methods compared by Friday.
best_for_zh: 手头有三十篇综述用的论文，想在周五前比完各自的方法。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://labs.google/ (graduated products) and blog.google July 2026 AI round）。 RENAME: NotebookLM was renamed Gemini Notebook on 2026-07-16.
